subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map, procurement steps & MAP draft for Thrive Systems
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alan Chen <alan.chen@thrive-systems.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@thrive-systems.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Stakeholder map, procurement steps & MAP draft for Thrive Systems

Hi Alan / Priya — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment heading into procurement/legal: 

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary use case: multi-tenant inference for customer-support summarization (approx 10k monthly active users, peak concurrency ~120).
- Decision criteria: latency (p95 < 250ms), predictable unit cost, and strong audit logs + retention controls.
- Procurement path: Alan will own econ buyer engagement (CFO); Priya will own security vendor sign-off and will need SOC2 evidence + vendor questionnaire answers.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft):
1) Security questionnaire kickoff — Redwood to deliver completed questionnaire + SOC2 report (ETA: 3 business days)
2) Procurement checklist submission — Alan to circulate internal procurement timeline and required PO/contract templates (ETA: Alan by 7/21)
3) Pricing & commercial terms — Jordan + Marissa to share preliminary pricing and MAP milestones; target commercial review 7/26
4) Demo & SRE session — Dev to run a short perf workshop (3/28?) to validate p95 latency at sample QPS

Attachments: I’ve attached a procurement checklist template and a blank MAP (Thrive_MAP_v1.xlsx) for us to align on milestones.

Would you confirm the owner for Contract/Legal (if it's not Alan) and whether Thrive requires an NDA before we share SOC2 artifacts?

Available for a 30m follow-up on Wednesday 7/21 between 9–12 PT — send a time that works and I’ll put it on the calendar.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alan Chen <alan.chen@thrive-systems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@thrive-systems.com>, Emily Rivers <erivers@thrive-systems.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder map, procurement steps & MAP draft for Thrive Systems

Thanks Jordan — good summary. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- Econ buyer: CFO (Marcus Holt) will be final approver for any >$100k ARR commits. I’ll intro Marcus if we get to a commercial draft.
- Timeline: Our standard procurement window for a first external vendor is ~3 weeks if there are no legal redlines. If legal pushes changes it can extend.
- PO vs contract: We typically prefer post-execution PO + SOW for first-year trials; legal prefers an initial vendor agreement for core security terms.

I’ve attached our internal procurement checklist (procurement_checklist.pdf) — highlights include: insurance certificate, reseller/partner addendum (if applicable), and a signed DPA for data residency/retention.

On the SOC2: we’ll need the SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months) and a point of contact for incident response questions. No NDA required to start, but legal will request a completed vendor questionnaire.

Next step: I’ll send an internal timeline by tomorrow EOD and loop Marcus if we hit pricing territory.

Best,
Alan Chen
Head of Procurement | Thrive Systems
alan.chen@thrive-systems.com

---
Attachment stub: procurement_checklist.pdf (Thrive internal checklist)

Jordan — adding a few security items we need before we can recommend moving to the CFO: 

- SOC2 Type II (last 12 months) + SOC2 cover letter describing in-scope services.
- Vendor security questionnaire (we sent a template in the thread) — please populate the controls section and provide evidence links for encryption at rest/in transit, RBAC, and key management.
- Data retention & deletion policy; need to confirm whether Redwood can support 30/60/90 day retention windows per environment.
- Incident response contact and SLAs for security incidents.

If you can send the questionnaire, I’ll assign it to our InfoSec reviewer (Emily Rivers) for a 48-hour turnaround. Also, we prefer to run a short security call (~30m) to review high-risk items rather than pass documentation back and forth.

Thanks,
